title: Surgical Technologists
description: Assist in operations, under the supervision of surgeons, registered nurses, or other surgical personnel. May help set up operating room, prepare and transport patients for surgery, adjust lights and equipment, pass instruments and other supplies to surgeons and surgeons' assistants, hold retractors, cut sutures, and help count sponges, needles, supplies, and instruments.

tasks.text: Maintain a proper sterile field during surgical procedures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Maintaining sterile field requires hands

tasks.text: Count sponges, needles, and instruments before and after operation.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Medical supply inventory records and thresholds automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventory of medical supplies or equipment.

tasks.text: Hand instruments and supplies to surgeons and surgeons' assistants, hold retractors and cut sutures, and perform other tasks as directed by surgeon during operation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sterile hands-on surgical assistance

tasks.text: Scrub arms and hands and assist the surgical team to scrub and put on gloves, masks, and surgical clothing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sterile hands-on surgical assistance

tasks.text: Wash and sterilize equipment, using germicides and sterilizers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Loading and operating sterilizing equipment by hand

tasks.text: Prepare patients for surgery, including positioning patients on the operating table and covering them with sterile surgical drapes to prevent exposure.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically applying safety equipment to people

dwas.name: Protect patients or staff members using safety equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

dwas.name: Position patients for treatment or examination.

tasks.text: Prepare, care for, and dispose of tissue specimens taken for laboratory analysis.

dwas.name: Prepare biological specimens for laboratory analysis.

tasks.text: Monitor and continually assess operating room conditions, including patient and surgical team needs.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Systems data monitored by AI; facilities need human oversight

dwas.name: Monitor patient conditions during treatments, procedures, or activities.

tasks.text: Prepare dressings or bandages and apply or assist with their application following surgery.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying bandages and splints needs manual dexterity

tasks.text: Clean and restock operating room, gathering and placing equipment and supplies and arranging instruments according to instructions, such as a preference card.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Medical supply inventory records and thresholds automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventory of medical supplies or equipment.

tasks.text: Provide technical assistance to surgeons, surgical nurses, or anesthesiologists.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sterile hands-on surgical assistance

tasks.text: Operate, assemble, adjust, or monitor sterilizers, lights, suction machines, or diagnostic equipment to ensure proper operation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Diagnostic instruments applied to patients by hand

dwas.name: Adjust settings or positions of medical equipment.
Operate diagnostic or therapeutic medical instruments or equipment.

tasks.text: Maintain supply of fluids, such as plasma, saline, blood, or glucose, for use during operations.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Medical supply inventory records and thresholds automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventory of medical supplies or equipment.

tasks.rationale: decision support — Calendar scheduling automatable; exceptions need human judgment
decision support — Medical supply ordering via systems; human approves

tasks.text: Maintain files and records of surgical procedures.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

tasks.text: Observe patients' vital signs to assess physical condition.
tasks.rationale: decision support — In-procedure patient monitoring is hands-on clinical work

dwas.name: Monitor patient conditions during treatments, procedures, or activities.

tasks.text: Transport patients to and from the operating room.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical escort and transportation of people

dwas.name: Move patients to or from treatment areas.
